name: Absolute Clean Energy Public Company Limited
summary: Absolute Clean Energy Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes electricity and steam from renewable energy in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Biomass Power Plants, Solid Waste Power Plants, Natural Gas Power Plants, and Solar Energy Power Plants. It holds 45 COD powerplants with a total of 440.22 megawatts. Absolute Clean Energy Public Company Limited was founded in 1979 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
